title: Multi-Granularity Cross-modal Alignment for Generalized Medical Visual Representation Learning
layout_note: Real chest X-rays (top left) feed the image encoder bar; reports and words (bottom left) feed the text encoder bar; between and beside them three alignment modules in tinted regions (token-wise, instance-wise matrix, prototype clustering).
grouping: Each alignment module is a tinted rounded region titled with its coloured abbreviation; the abbreviations are expanded in a dashed key box at the bottom right.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded bars for the encoders (green image, purple text), embeddings as coloured cell columns, a similarity matrix with blue positives.
proposed_highlight: The three granularities are the three tinted regions, each named by a coloured abbreviation.
lesson: Colour the image path green and the text path purple all the way through, and give each alignment objective its own tinted region with its own abbreviation.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year; remembered venue NeurIPS 2022 (not verified in this session). Card written while studying arrangement (2026-11-15).

arrangement.units: three tinted regions, one per alignment objective, between and right of the encoder bars
arrangement.inputs_as: real X-ray thumbnails and quoted report lines and words
arrangement.losses_at: each objective in its own tinted region where the two modalities meet

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Green Image Encoder bar on top and purple Text Encoder bar at the bottom, with three tinted regions for the objectives: yellow CTA between the encoders, pink ITA similarity matrix to the right, blue CPA prototype-clustering panel at the far right.
insights.data: Inputs are real chest X-rays with zoomed patch circles and quoted report lines split into word chips; representations are vertical columns of green or purple squares, token embeddings are multi-coloured cell rows, and the ITA is a 4 x 4 grid with blue diagonal cells.
insights.emphasis: Each alignment objective gets its own tinted region with its acronym in a matching colour (CTA orange, ITA red, CPA blue), explained in a dashed key at bottom right.
insights.flow: Left to right from inputs to encoders to representation columns; green lines run from the image side and purple lines from the text side into each objective, with curved black 'Align' arrows inside CTA.
insights.avoid: The purple 'Query' lines in CTA loop around the cross-attention boxes and cross the green ones, making the token-wise alignment hard to trace.
